summary: Iteration 4: Foundation + Onboarding testing. Backend: all 16 tests PASS (business profile, team, notif prefs, notifications list/synth/mark-all, onboarding state, auth_required isolation, onboarding_complete mirror to user). Frontend: Register form renders all 8 fields + trust column (3 testimonials + 5 guarantees) correctly. Wizard auto-triggers after register at /dashboard showing Step 1. Step 1 -> Step 2 navigation works. Settings page renders all 6 tabs. Notifications page renders all 6 filter tabs + mark-all. Sidebar has Alerts + Settings nav. HOWEVER, several expected data-testid selectors for Settings sub-tabs are MISSING (notif-days-60/30/14/7, notif-delivery, notif-threshold, notif-weekly, notif-digest, notif-save, team-invite-btn). Also the X close button in onboarding wizard does NOT close the wizard (only 'Save & exit' works).

ui_bugs.issue: X close button in wizard header does NOT dismiss the wizard. Only 'Save & exit' text link works. Per spec the X should also close the wizard.

Expected data-testid selectors are missing from rendered DOM: notif-days-60, notif-days-30, notif-days-14, notif-days-7, notif-delivery, notif-threshold, notif-weekly, notif-digest, notif-save. Either the Notifications tab is not rendering its controls, or the testids differ from the spec (main agent should verify /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx).

Expected data-testid 'team-invite-btn' is missing after clicking settings-tab-team. Invite flow cannot be exercised via the documented selectors. team-invite-email / team-invite-role / team-invite-submit also not verifiable without the trigger button.

integration_issues.issue: No 'Skip' button is visible on Step 3. Since EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is exhausted, 'Generate with AI' will 503/timeout and leaves the user stuck on Step 3 with Back + Generate buttons only. Wizard does not appear to auto-advance on AI failure as the task description claimed it would. Main agent should either (a) add a Skip button on Step 3 or (b) verify the auto-advance-on-error path actually triggers next(step) in the catch block.

action_items: Verify/fix data-testid attributes in /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx for Notifications sub-tab: notif-days-60/30/14/7, notif-delivery, notif-threshold, notif-weekly, notif-digest, notif-save
Verify/fix data-testid='team-invite-btn' (and the invite dialog testids team-invite-email, team-invite-role, team-invite-submit) in Settings Team sub-tab
Add onClick handler to the X icon button in OnboardingWizard header to dismiss the wizard (currently only 'Save & exit' text link works)
Add a Skip button to Onboarding Step 3 OR verify the 'proceed on AI error' fallback actually advances to step 4 (LLM budget is exhausted so AI gen will 503 in this env)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py - all new Foundation endpoints are clean: proper user_id isolation, Pydantic validation, no _id leakage, sensible defaults. Onboarding completion correctly mirrors onboarding_complete=true onto users collection so /auth/me reflects state.
server.py:735-763 - /notifications synthesis path is elegant (falls back to live-derived notifications from licences/incidents when no stored notifications exist).
server.py:654-658 - /team/invite lowercases email on lookup but the duplicate check uses body.email.lower() - good, but consider using EmailStr's normalized form consistently.
OnboardingWizard.jsx - Step 3 lacks a skip option which creates a hard dead-end when AI provider is unavailable.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% - registration, wizard auto-trigger, step1->step2, settings page shell, notifications page, sidebar nav all work; notif+team sub-tab testids and wizard X button are broken/missing

test_credentials: Fresh registrations used: foundation_test_<random>@safetradie.demo / Demo@1234. Existing demo accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (owner@safetradie.demo / Demo@1234) not used for new-user onboarding flow.
seed_data_creation: None beyond TEST_ prefixed business profile + invite records created via automated tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid - no need to re-run /app/backend/tests/test_foundation_onboarding.py unless endpoints change. Frontend reproduction recipe: (1) register fresh email, (2) observe wizard auto-opens, (3) verify the 3 action items above. Wizard step 3 dead-end blocks full 6-step flow test in this env because LLM budget is exhausted - main agent should implement the skip/auto-advance-on-error path, then next agent can complete the wizard-to-finish flow. All 6 notification filter testids and notif-mark-all exist on /dashboard/notifications. Sidebar already exposes Alerts+Settings nav.
rca of the issue: Settings Notifications/Team sub-tab testids missing: most likely the main agent used different testid names in Settings.jsx than what was spec'd in the review request (e.g. 'notif-delivery-select' vs 'notif-delivery') OR the sub-tab content isn't conditionally rendering. Main agent should grep /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx for data-testid= attributes and align with spec. Wizard X-button-non-functional: likely the <X/> icon button has no onClick={onClose} wired up; only the 'Save & exit' link has the handler. Step 3 no-skip: design choice or missing fallback in catch(err) => setStep(next).
